episodes.synopsis: Responsible Taihei has to deal with his lazy little sister, Umaru, who trashes his apartment and throws tantrums to get manga and junk food.
episodes.title: Umaru and Her Brother

episodes.synopsis: Taihei comes home to a complete stranger: Umaru’s public face. She’s cleaned the apartment and hidden her games to be able to invite her classmate and neighbor, Ebina, over.
episodes.title: Umaru and Ebina

episodes.synopsis: Umaru’s sulky, glaring classmate, Motoba, has unexpectedly shown up at her door… while she’s wearing her hood! Is her secret out?
episodes.title: Umaru and Her Disciple

episodes.synopsis: Umaru, aka UMR, is a force to be reckoned with in the arcade. She’s invited to participate in a fighting game championship only to bump into her school rival, Tachibana.
episodes.title: Umaru and Her Rival

episodes.synopsis: Summer vacation means hours at the arcade! Umaru instructs in the fine art of enjoying summer like a (lazy) pro. Later, Taihei endures another typical day at work.
episodes.title: Umaru and Summer Vacation

episodes.synopsis: Taihei and Umaru experiment with free time and personal space in their little apartment, and playing “The Game of Life” hits too close to home for them all.
episodes.title: Umaru’s Birthday

episodes.synopsis: People in his office have seen Taihei walking home and going shopping with a hot girl! His coworker comes over for a visit to see this so-called “sister” for himself.
episodes.title: Umaru’s Big Brother

episodes.synopsis: In the Doma household, winter means lazy days beneath the kotatsu! Umaru reflects on her interesting year while Taihei tries to collect on a promise she made to him.
episodes.title: Umaru and Christmas and New Year's

episodes.synopsis: It’s Valentine’s Day! Kirie burns cookies, Ebina attempts to make chocolate, and Umaru continues to offload food prep to Taihei.
episodes.title: Umaru and Valentine’s

episodes.synopsis: Umaru gets sick, but it’s a good thing her germs are as lazy as she is! Sadly, her germs show her brother no mercy. Later, Taihei remembers a day at the arcade, 10 years ago.
episodes.title: Umaru and Now and Once Upon a Time

episodes.synopsis: Umaru and Ebina discover that their appetites match, the council in Umaru’s head furiously debates about the perfect snack, and Taihei tries to get Kirie excited for summer.
episodes.title: Umaru's Everyday Life

episodes.synopsis: In this last episode of the season, Umaru might have to reveal her secret when her separate circles of friends come together during a much anticipated trip to the beach!
episodes.title: Umaru and Everyone
